meta.operator_note: Authorized testing of the operator's own Roblox experience. Client is treated as untrusted; the server is the authority.

scenarios.name: Speed hack (excessive walk speed)
scenarios.description: Client reports horizontal displacement implying a speed above the allowed maximum.
scenarios.objective: Verify the server rejects or clamps movement that exceeds the configured max speed.
scenarios.initial_conditions: Player spawned on a flat baseplate; server max speed configured.
scenarios.procedure: Harness fires movement updates whose delta implies speed > maxSpeed for several ticks.
scenarios.expected_result: Server rejects/corrects position (snapback) and flags the anomaly; no speed advantage persists.

scenarios.name: Teleport (impossible displacement)
scenarios.description: Position jumps a large distance within a single tick (no path, no dt to justify it).
scenarios.objective: Verify the server detects an impossible single-tick displacement and rejects it.
scenarios.initial_conditions: Player at a known position; server tracks last authoritative position and time.
scenarios.procedure: Harness sets a new position far from the last authoritative one within one tick.
scenarios.expected_result: Server rejects the teleport and restores the last valid position; anomaly logged.

scenarios.name: Fly (sustained unsupported altitude)
scenarios.description: Vertical position stays elevated with no supporting part / jump arc.
scenarios.objective: Verify the server detects sustained unsupported altitude.
scenarios.initial_conditions: Player on ground; raycast-based ground check available server-side.
scenarios.procedure: Harness reports elevated Y for longer than a normal jump could sustain.
scenarios.expected_result: Server flags sustained unsupported altitude and corrects/denies the state.

scenarios.name: Noclip (movement through collision)
scenarios.description: Position crosses a solid boundary the server knows about.
scenarios.objective: Verify the server validates movement against server-side collision/zones.
scenarios.initial_conditions: A server-known solid wall / restricted zone exists.
scenarios.procedure: Harness reports a path that passes through the solid boundary.
scenarios.expected_result: Server rejects the crossing; player cannot occupy the restricted space.

scenarios.name: Infinite jump (repeated jumps while airborne)
scenarios.description: Jump requested repeatedly without ever touching the ground.
scenarios.objective: Verify jumps are only honored when the server believes the player is grounded.
scenarios.procedure: Harness requests jump N times while server-side grounded state is false.
scenarios.expected_result: Server honors at most one jump until grounded again; extra jumps rejected.

scenarios.name: Unexpected argument types
scenarios.description: A RemoteEvent is fired with argument types it does not expect.
scenarios.objective: Verify the server validates argument types and rejects malformed calls.
scenarios.initial_conditions: A RemoteEvent with a known expected signature.
scenarios.procedure: Harness fires the remote with wrong types (string where number expected, table, nil...).
scenarios.expected_result: Server rejects the call, logs it, and does not mutate state.

scenarios.name: Out-of-range / extreme / NaN / Inf values
scenarios.description: Numeric arguments are negative, extreme, NaN or Infinity.
scenarios.objective: Verify the server range-checks numbers and rejects NaN/Inf/negative where invalid.
scenarios.initial_conditions: A RemoteEvent accepting a bounded numeric argument.
scenarios.procedure: Harness sends -1, 1e308, NaN, math.huge for a quantity that must be a small positive int.
scenarios.expected_result: Server rejects every invalid value; no state change.

scenarios.name: Excessive call frequency (rate limit)
scenarios.description: A RemoteEvent is fired far faster than any legitimate client would.
scenarios.objective: Verify server-side per-player rate limiting throttles/denies floods.
scenarios.initial_conditions: Rate limiter configured for the remote.
scenarios.procedure: Harness fires the remote N times within a short window.
scenarios.expected_result: Calls beyond the limit are dropped/denied and logged; server stays responsive.

scenarios.name: Client-authoritative field mutation attempt
scenarios.description: Client tries to set a value only the server should own (e.g. its own balance).
scenarios.objective: Verify the server ignores client-supplied values for server-owned state.
scenarios.procedure: Harness fires a remote carrying a desired balance value.
scenarios.expected_result: Server ignores the client value and derives state itself; attempt logged.

scenarios.name: Unauthorized coin alteration
scenarios.description: Attempt to increase currency without a valid, server-verified transaction.
scenarios.objective: Verify currency only changes through server-validated transactions.
scenarios.initial_conditions: Player has a known server-held balance.
scenarios.procedure: Harness requests a balance increase with no backing purchase/reward.
scenarios.expected_result: Server denies the change; balance unchanged; attempt logged.

scenarios.name: Negative amount transaction
scenarios.description: A transaction with a negative quantity/price.
scenarios.objective: Verify the server rejects negative amounts (no refund/drain exploits).
scenarios.procedure: Harness submits a transaction with amount < 0.
scenarios.expected_result: Server rejects it; no balance movement.

scenarios.name: Duplicate / replayed reward claim
scenarios.description: The same one-time reward claim is submitted twice.
scenarios.objective: Verify reward grants are idempotent (server-tracked, single-grant).
scenarios.initial_conditions: A one-time reward the player has already claimed.
scenarios.expected_result: Second claim is denied; reward granted exactly once.

scenarios.name: Repeated purchase race (double-spend)
scenarios.description: Many purchase requests fired concurrently to try to spend the same funds twice.
scenarios.objective: Verify the server serializes/locks balance mutations.
scenarios.initial_conditions: Balance only sufficient for one purchase.
scenarios.procedure: Harness fires several concurrent purchase requests.
scenarios.expected_result: At most one purchase succeeds; balance never goes negative.

scenarios.name: Inventory manipulation (grant unowned item)
scenarios.description: Attempt to add an item the player never legitimately obtained.
scenarios.objective: Verify inventory additions require a server-validated source.
scenarios.procedure: Harness requests adding an item id with no valid acquisition.
scenarios.expected_result: Server denies the addition; inventory unchanged.

scenarios.name: Non-admin invokes admin action
scenarios.description: A player without the admin role calls an admin-only remote.
scenarios.objective: Verify the server checks role before executing privileged actions.
scenarios.initial_conditions: Caller has no admin role server-side.
scenarios.procedure: Harness invokes an admin remote as a normal player.
scenarios.expected_result: Server denies the action and logs the attempt.

scenarios.name: Restricted function from unauthorized context
scenarios.description: A restricted function is invoked from a context not allowed to call it.
scenarios.objective: Verify restricted functions validate the caller/context, not just presence.
scenarios.initial_conditions: A function restricted to a specific role/context.
scenarios.procedure: Harness invokes it from an unauthorized context.

scenarios.name: Privilege escalation via role self-assignment
scenarios.description: A player attempts to assign themselves a higher role.
scenarios.objective: Verify role assignment is server-controlled and not client-driven.
scenarios.initial_conditions: Role data owned by the server.
scenarios.procedure: Harness requests assigning itself the admin role.
scenarios.expected_result: Server denies; role unchanged; attempt logged.
